scope: Original generated concepts, Hyper3D Rodin meshes and shaded atlases, Blender-fitted/exported models and original action symbols. Native bodies, faces, hair and backpacks remain game-owned.

generation.concepts: Original generated images with retained prompts.
generation.geometryAndTextures: Hyper3D Rodin outputs from original concepts; Blender fitting, skinning, capped fragments and display variants.
generation.actionSymbols: Original generated flat symbols from written native-style observations; no native pixels used as image input.
generation.rightsStatus: Author confirmed on 2026-09-25 that Creator was active when the models were generated. Official Rodin terms sections 5(b) and 6.3 reviewed for this release. Account status is author-reported, not independently provider-verified. See paladin/ASSET-LICENSE.md.

rightsSources.scope: Rodin section 5(b), applicable restrictions and section 6.3 recipient notice

testedGame.scope: Female static tier previews, selected combat/action UI observations and starter/equipment ability ownership checks. Not complete model, skinset or lifecycle acceptance.

remainingGates: Male apparel native fit and motion; other native appearances and all-skinset coverage.

sourceStorage.sourceEvidenceAndFileSourceFields: Archive-relative ledger identifiers from the retained authoring campaign, not downloadable repository links. The campaign and its raw generation/editing sources are retained separately and are not bundled in this source checkout or runtime release.
sourceStorage.runtimeInventory: The files map pins every distributed runtime PNG/GLB under marketplace/packages/paladin/assets. Those installed assets and rendererRoutes are reproducible package validation inputs.
sourceStorage.acceptanceBoundary: Source hashes establish identity and provenance, not universal fit, animation or distribution entitlement.
